rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for an aircraft pilot.

example.english: Yesterday I flew on a plane, and the pilot was very polite.
example.traditional: 我尋日搭飛機，個機師講嘢好有禮貌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 daap3 fei1 gei1 go3 gei1 si1 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this for something conducted as a test or trial before wider implementation.

example.english: This pilot project isn't finished yet; it still needs to be tested a few more times.
example.traditional: 呢個試驗計劃仲未完成，仲要再試多次。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si3 jim6 gai3 waak6 zung6 mei6 jyun4 sing4 zung6 jiu3 zoi3 si3 do1 ci3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a sample episode made to test a proposed television series.

example.english: The TV station will decide whether to make the series after watching the pilot.
example.traditional: 電視台睇完試播集，先決定開唔開呢套劇。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 tai2 jyun4 si3 bo3 zaap6 sin1 kyut3 ding6 hoi1 m4 hoi1 ni1 tou3 kek6
